t: Hing Wah Paste Manufacturing Co (興華製麵) – The Industrial History of Hong Kong Group
s: From inception, Hing Wah, whose name stands for “reviving China”, capitalized on the movement of supporting Chinese-made products, which started in 1905 with the Anti-American boycott and spawned firms such as Nanyang Brothers Tobacco, China Can and Chinese Foreign Knitting Co (all covered earlier in other articles, the latter two received investments from Hing Wah board member Hsien and Choy respectively). Hing Wah’s Chinese advertising and box packaging highlighted the patriotic sentiments in buying their products while also emphasized product quality as its products were certified free of harmful ingredients by HK government analysts and British chemists.
